title: Reissue Validity Methods Keyed to the Certificate's Last Usable Day — Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus
content:
**Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus — certificates reissued after a return on Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders.** The reissue validity is produced by one of three methods, set by the last usable day of the certificate being reissued, read against two dates: the reissue date, and the refund date of the return as the Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders return refund records it. Each method starts from the certificate validity days of the tier held (30 for Pals Rewards Member and Pals Rewards Insider, 45 for Pals Rewards VIP, Tailwise Plus Monthly and Tailwise Plus Annual, 60 for Tailwise Plus Premier Annual).

| Last usable day of the certificate being reissued | Days produced |
|---|---|
| on or after the reissue date | the tier's validity days plus the days that certificate still has left, counted from the reissue date through its last usable day with both days counted |
| before the reissue date, but on or after the refund date of the return | the tier's validity days plus the calendar days from that last usable day to the reissue date |
| before the refund date of the return | the tier's validity days alone |

**Worked dates (hypothetical, Pals Rewards VIP, 45 days, reissue on 10 June).**

| Last usable day | Refund date | Days produced |
|---|---|---|
| 15 June | 1 June | 45 plus 6 (10 to 15 June, both counted) is 51 |
| 10 June | 1 June | 45 plus 1 is 46 |
| 5 June | 1 June | 45 plus 5 (5 June to 10 June) is 50 |
| 1 June | 1 June | 45 plus 9 is 54 |
| 20 May | 1 June | 45 |
